text:
Camille Torres: Kicking off a short pilot for an SI onboarding program (working name: "SI Apprentice"). Goal: reproducible onboarding that includes a hands-on lab, a cert badge, and a marketplace-ready listing. Need decisions on scope + costs.

Evan Brooks: Scope idea: 3 modules: 1) API & quickstart + security, 2) Deployment patterns (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), 3) Marketplace + Ops (billing, listing). Add a final lab that ties them together.

Leah Kim: For labs we need isolated sandboxes per SI with ephemeral creds. We can run in staging org: each sandbox = VPC + 1 control node + optional GPU node. Estimated cost: CPU-only cohort ~ $1.8k, GPU-inclusive ~ $3.5k.

Diego Navarro: Marketplace checklist: listing metadata, logo assets, co-sell blurb, validated billing flow, sample contract language. Also need a short JSON schema for the listing that SIs can test against.

Camille Torres: Certification levels? Bronze = course completion + quiz, Silver = lab pass (practical), Gold = joint-customer demo + case study. Thoughts?

Evan Brooks: Agreed. Add measurable pass criteria for lab: deploy a model variant, run a load smoke test, and show failover to fallback model within Xs. Suggest exam rubric: deploy (40%), tests (40%), docs & runbook (20%).

partner-bot: Action: Create LMS course shell, tag it 'SI-Onboard-2026', and request instructor slots by 2026-05-10.

Leah Kim: For infra provisioning here's the quick CLI to create an ephemeral sandbox (staging-only):
```
redwood infra create-sandbox --org staging --name si-apprentice-<si-name> \
  --vpc /vpcs/staging-1 --gpu type=a100,count=1 --ttl 72h
```
Will return creds and a jumpbox url.

Diego Navarro: We'll prepare a sample listing JSON and co-marketing checklist. Also want to lock a PR window with marketing for a short joint announcement after first Gold.

Evan Brooks: Volunteer to author the deployment templates and the failover lab scenarios. Will draft by next Tue.

Camille Torres: Need a primary trainer for the pilot. @Evan do you want to run the first cohort? Also need one engineer to own sandbox ops (Leah?), and one partner PM to recruit 2 pilot SIs.

Leah Kim: I can own sandbox ops for the pilot; will instrument cost tracking and access controls.

partner-bot: Reminder: Add partner SSO to partner-portal and create partner spaces for sandbox access.

Diego Navarro: Timeline proposal: materials ready 2026-05-01, pilot signups 2026-05-05, cohort runs 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-15. Post-pilot: case study + webinar in July.

Camille Torres: Nice. Action items I captured: Evan = deployment templates & exam rubric; Leah = sandbox ops + cost tracker; Diego = marketplace JSON + co-marketing plan; partner-bot = LMS/course shell + SSO checklist. I'll put into Notion and schedule a 30m kickoff this Friday. Thanks all!
